blocks.prompt: 8 (i) Prove that in any triangle \(ABC\): \(b = c\cos A + a\cos C\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh projection law hai: side \(b\) baqi do sides ke us par saayon (projections) ka jama hai.
Rule kaunsa? \(\underline{a} + \underline{b} + \underline{c} = \underline{0}\) aur dot product ke exterior angles.
Plan: \(\underline{b}\) ko baqi do mein likhein, dono taraf \(\underline{b}\) se dot product lein, phir \(b\) se divide karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: triangle \(ABC\), sides \(a = BC\), \(b = CA\), \(c = AB\).
Saabit karna hai: \(b = c\cos A + a\cos C\).
Tareeqa: Triangle ko vectors ki shakal mein likh kar dot product, bilkul Example 7(ii) jaisa. Wahan \(a\) ke liye kiya tha, yahan \(b\) ke liye.

Tayyari (Example 7 ki tarah)
Maan lein \(\underline{a}\), \(\underline{b}\), \(\underline{c}\) sides \(BC\), \(CA\), \(AB\) ke along hain, to
\[\underline{a} + \underline{b} + \underline{c} = \underline{0}\]
aur \(|\underline{a}| = a\), \(|\underline{b}| = b\), \(|\underline{c}| = c\). In vectors ki tails milayein to \(\underline{b}\) aur \(\underline{c}\) ke beech angle \(\pi - A\) hai, is liye
\[\underline{b}\cdot\underline{c} = bc\cos(\pi - A) = -bc\cos A\]
\[\underline{c}\cdot\underline{a} = -ca\cos B\]
\[\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b} = -ab\cos C\]
Kyun: Triangle ke gird head to tail chalein to wapas wahin pahunch jate hain jahan se chale the; kul safar zero, is liye teeno ka jama zero vector hai. \(\underline{b}\) (\(C\) se \(A\) ki taraf) aur \(\underline{c}\) (\(A\) se \(B\) ki taraf) \(A\) par head to tail milte hain; dot product ke liye angle tail to tail naapte hain, jo andar wale angle \(A\) ka bahir wala hissa \(\pi - A\) banta hai. Aur \(\cos(\pi - x) = -\cos x\).
Dhyan dein: Yahan angle \(A\) nahi, \(\pi - A\) hai; isi wajah se formulas mein minus aata hai.

\(\underline{b} = -\underline{a} - \underline{c}\) ka \(\underline{b}\) se dot product
\[\underline{b}\cdot\underline{b} = -\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b} - \underline{c}\cdot\underline{b}\]
\[b^2 = ab\cos C + bc\cos A\]
Kyun: \(\underline{a} + \underline{b} + \underline{c} = \underline{0}\) se \(\underline{b} = -\underline{a} - \underline{c}\). Dono taraf \(\underline{b}\) se dot product liya. Kisi vector ka apne aap se dot product us ki length ka square hota hai: \(\underline{b}\cdot\underline{b} = b^2\). Tayyari wale results se \(-\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b} = ab\cos C\) aur \(-\underline{c}\cdot\underline{b} = bc\cos A\); minus into minus plus ho gaya.

\(b\) se divide karein
\[b = a\cos C + c\cos A\]
Kyun: \(b\) triangle ki side hai, zero nahi ho sakti, is liye dono taraf \(b\) se divide kar sakte hain. Yeh wohi hai jo saabit karna tha (sirf terms ki tarteeb mukhtalif).

Tasdeeq
\[\text{Equilateral, side 1:}\]
\[1 = \tfrac{1}{2} + \tfrac{1}{2} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Equilateral triangle mein har angle \(60^{\circ}\) aur \(\cos 60^{\circ} = \frac{1}{2}\). Dono taraf 1 aaya, formula sahi chalta hai.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(b = c\cos A + a\cos C\).

blocks.prompt: 8 (ii) Prove that in any triangle \(ABC\): \(c = a\cos B + b\cos A\)
blocks.explanation:
Side \(c\) ke liye projection law; part (i) jaisa hi kaam.
Plan: \(\underline{c} = -\underline{a} - \underline{b}\), dono taraf \(\underline{c}\) se dot product, phir \(c\) se divide.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: triangle \(ABC\).
Saabit karna hai: \(c = a\cos B + b\cos A\).
Tareeqa: Part (i) wala hi tareeqa, bas is dafa \(\underline{c}\) ko akela karenge.

Tayyari (Example 7 ki tarah)
Maan lein \(\underline{a}\), \(\underline{b}\), \(\underline{c}\) sides \(BC\), \(CA\), \(AB\) ke along hain, to
\[\underline{a} + \underline{b} + \underline{c} = \underline{0}\]
aur \(|\underline{a}| = a\), \(|\underline{b}| = b\), \(|\underline{c}| = c\). In vectors ki tails milayein to \(\underline{b}\) aur \(\underline{c}\) ke beech angle \(\pi - A\) hai, is liye
\[\underline{b}\cdot\underline{c} = bc\cos(\pi - A) = -bc\cos A\]
\[\underline{c}\cdot\underline{a} = -ca\cos B\]
\[\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b} = -ab\cos C\]
Kyun: Triangle ke gird head to tail chalein to wapas wahin pahunch jate hain jahan se chale the; kul safar zero, is liye teeno ka jama zero vector hai. \(\underline{b}\) (\(C\) se \(A\) ki taraf) aur \(\underline{c}\) (\(A\) se \(B\) ki taraf) \(A\) par head to tail milte hain; dot product ke liye angle tail to tail naapte hain, jo andar wale angle \(A\) ka bahir wala hissa \(\pi - A\) banta hai. Aur \(\cos(\pi - x) = -\cos x\).
Dhyan dein: Yahan angle \(A\) nahi, \(\pi - A\) hai; isi wajah se formulas mein minus aata hai.

\(\underline{c} = -\underline{a} - \underline{b}\) ka \(\underline{c}\) se dot product
\[\underline{c}\cdot\underline{c} = -\underline{a}\cdot\underline{c} - \underline{b}\cdot\underline{c}\]
\[c^2 = ca\cos B + bc\cos A\]
Kyun: \(\underline{a} + \underline{b} + \underline{c} = \underline{0}\) se \(\underline{c} = -\underline{a} - \underline{b}\). \(\underline{c}\cdot\underline{c} = c^2\). Tayyari se \(\underline{c}\cdot\underline{a} = -ca\cos B\) aur \(\underline{b}\cdot\underline{c} = -bc\cos A\); aage minus laga hai, is liye dono plus ban gaye.

\(c\) se divide karein
\[c = a\cos B + b\cos A\]
Kyun: \(c\) side hai, zero nahi.

Tasdeeq
\[\text{Right angle at } C:\]
\[a = 3,\ b = 4,\ c = 5\]
\[3 \cdot \tfrac{3}{5} + 4 \cdot \tfrac{4}{5}\]
\[= \tfrac{25}{5} = 5 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: 3-4-5 wale right triangle mein \(\cos B = \frac{3}{5}\) aur \(\cos A = \frac{4}{5}\) (adjacent over hypotenuse). Jawab 5 aaya, jo \(c\) hai.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(c = a\cos B + b\cos A\).

blocks.prompt: 8 (iii) Prove that in any triangle \(ABC\): \(b^2 = c^2 + a^2 - 2ca\cos B\)
blocks.explanation:
Side \(b\) ke liye cosine law.
Rule kaunsa? \(\underline{b}\cdot\underline{b} = b^2\) aur tayyari wala \(\underline{c}\cdot\underline{a} = -ca\cos B\).
Plan: \(\underline{b} = -(\underline{c} + \underline{a})\), phir dono taraf apne aap se dot product.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: triangle \(ABC\).
Saabit karna hai: \(b^2 = c^2 + a^2 - 2ca\cos B\).
Tareeqa: Example 7(i) ki tarah vector equation ko dot product se 'square' karenge.

Tayyari (Example 7 ki tarah)
Maan lein \(\underline{a}\), \(\underline{b}\), \(\underline{c}\) sides \(BC\), \(CA\), \(AB\) ke along hain, to
\[\underline{a} + \underline{b} + \underline{c} = \underline{0}\]
aur \(|\underline{a}| = a\), \(|\underline{b}| = b\), \(|\underline{c}| = c\). In vectors ki tails milayein to \(\underline{b}\) aur \(\underline{c}\) ke beech angle \(\pi - A\) hai, is liye
\[\underline{b}\cdot\underline{c} = bc\cos(\pi - A) = -bc\cos A\]
\[\underline{c}\cdot\underline{a} = -ca\cos B\]
\[\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b} = -ab\cos C\]
Kyun: Triangle ke gird head to tail chalein to wapas wahin pahunch jate hain jahan se chale the; kul safar zero, is liye teeno ka jama zero vector hai. \(\underline{b}\) (\(C\) se \(A\) ki taraf) aur \(\underline{c}\) (\(A\) se \(B\) ki taraf) \(A\) par head to tail milte hain; dot product ke liye angle tail to tail naapte hain, jo andar wale angle \(A\) ka bahir wala hissa \(\pi - A\) banta hai. Aur \(\cos(\pi - x) = -\cos x\).
Dhyan dein: Yahan angle \(A\) nahi, \(\pi - A\) hai; isi wajah se formulas mein minus aata hai.

\(\underline{b} = -(\underline{c} + \underline{a})\) ka apne aap se dot product
\[\underline{b}\cdot\underline{b} = (\underline{c} + \underline{a})\cdot(\underline{c} + \underline{a})\]
\[= \underline{c}\cdot\underline{c} + 2\underline{c}\cdot\underline{a} + \underline{a}\cdot\underline{a}\]
Kyun: Dono taraf minus tha, minus into minus plus. Bracket ko \((x + y)^2\) ki tarah khola: \(\underline{c}\cdot\underline{c} + \underline{c}\cdot\underline{a} + \underline{a}\cdot\underline{c} + \underline{a}\cdot\underline{a}\). Dot product commutative hai (\(\underline{a}\cdot\underline{c} = \underline{c}\cdot\underline{a}\)), is liye beech wale do terms mil kar \(2\underline{c}\cdot\underline{a}\) bane.

Tayyari wala result lagayein
\[b^2 = c^2 + 2(-ca\cos B) + a^2\]
\[= c^2 + a^2 - 2ca\cos B\]
Kyun: \(\underline{b}\cdot\underline{b} = b^2\), \(\underline{c}\cdot\underline{c} = c^2\), \(\underline{a}\cdot\underline{a} = a^2\), aur \(\underline{c}\cdot\underline{a} = -ca\cos B\) (angle \(\pi - B\) ki wajah se). Bas yehi minus formula ka minus hai.
Dhyan dein: Agar aap angle \(B\) le lete to plus aata aur formula ghalat ho jata.

Tasdeeq
\[B = 90^{\circ}:\ b^2 = c^2 + a^2\]
Kyun: \(\cos 90^{\circ} = 0\) rakhne se Pythagoras theorem ban jata hai, aur waqai \(B\) right angle ho to \(b\) hypotenuse hoti hai. Cosine law Pythagoras ki aam shakal hai.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(b^2 = c^2 + a^2 - 2ca\cos B\).

blocks.prompt: 8 (iv) Prove that in any triangle \(ABC\): \(c^2 = a^2 + b^2 - 2ab\cos C\)
blocks.explanation:
Side \(c\) ke liye cosine law; part (iii) jaisa.
Plan: \(\underline{c} = -(\underline{a} + \underline{b})\), dono taraf apne aap se dot product, phir \(\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b} = -ab\cos C\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: triangle \(ABC\).
Saabit karna hai: \(c^2 = a^2 + b^2 - 2ab\cos C\).
Tareeqa: Part (iii) wala, bas \(\underline{c}\) ko akela karenge.

Tayyari (Example 7 ki tarah)
Maan lein \(\underline{a}\), \(\underline{b}\), \(\underline{c}\) sides \(BC\), \(CA\), \(AB\) ke along hain, to
\[\underline{a} + \underline{b} + \underline{c} = \underline{0}\]
aur \(|\underline{a}| = a\), \(|\underline{b}| = b\), \(|\underline{c}| = c\). In vectors ki tails milayein to \(\underline{b}\) aur \(\underline{c}\) ke beech angle \(\pi - A\) hai, is liye
\[\underline{b}\cdot\underline{c} = bc\cos(\pi - A) = -bc\cos A\]
\[\underline{c}\cdot\underline{a} = -ca\cos B\]
\[\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b} = -ab\cos C\]
Kyun: Triangle ke gird head to tail chalein to wapas wahin pahunch jate hain jahan se chale the; kul safar zero, is liye teeno ka jama zero vector hai. \(\underline{b}\) (\(C\) se \(A\) ki taraf) aur \(\underline{c}\) (\(A\) se \(B\) ki taraf) \(A\) par head to tail milte hain; dot product ke liye angle tail to tail naapte hain, jo andar wale angle \(A\) ka bahir wala hissa \(\pi - A\) banta hai. Aur \(\cos(\pi - x) = -\cos x\).
Dhyan dein: Yahan angle \(A\) nahi, \(\pi - A\) hai; isi wajah se formulas mein minus aata hai.

\(\underline{c} = -(\underline{a} + \underline{b})\) ka apne aap se dot product
\[\underline{c}\cdot\underline{c} = (\underline{a} + \underline{b})\cdot(\underline{a} + \underline{b})\]
\[= \underline{a}\cdot\underline{a} + 2\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b} + \underline{b}\cdot\underline{b}\]
Kyun: Minus into minus plus; bracket khola aur \(\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b} = \underline{b}\cdot\underline{a}\) hone ki wajah se beech ke do terms jur kar \(2\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b}\).

Tayyari wala result lagayein
\[c^2 = a^2 + 2(-ab\cos C) + b^2\]
\[= a^2 + b^2 - 2ab\cos C\]
Kyun: \(\underline{a}\) aur \(\underline{b}\) \(C\) par milte hain aur un ke beech tail to tail angle \(\pi - C\) hai, is liye \(\underline{a}\cdot\underline{b} = -ab\cos C\).

Tasdeeq
\[a = b = c,\ C = 60^{\circ}:\]
\[a^2 + a^2 - 2a^2 \cdot \tfrac{1}{2} = a^2 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Equilateral triangle mein \(C = 60^{\circ}\) aur \(\cos 60^{\circ} = \frac{1}{2}\); dono taraf \(a^2\) aaya.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(c^2 = a^2 + b^2 - 2ab\cos C\).
